correctness.rationale: Conditional same-loop shortest distances are uniform on half-circumferences and cross-loop distances sum independent uniforms. Exact algebra gives mu=(L-c)/4, nu=(L-c)^2/12, omega=((L-c)^3+c^3)/32 with c=ab/L. Necessity/sufficiency of 0<c<=4mu/3 and inversion by the quadratic discriminant follow, including strict/attained bounds. Exact cube-root inequality gives the modulus and a fixed-mean family c=epsilon versus 2epsilon proves exponent sharp. The standalone verifier checked rational conditional integrals and independent numerical shortest-path integration.

value.rationale: A natural minimal-statistics inverse geometry question is fully solved: two raw moments cannot detect a branch joining two circles or determine their lengths, while the third separates model classes, supplies an exact admissibility surface and gives an explicit inverse. The positive-cube contrast yields the optimal one-third reconstruction modulus for total length when one loop shrinks. This is a motivated complete classification and sharp information boundary, not an arbitrary new moment coefficient.
